text: When the elderly widow Edna [goes missing from her remote family home|trigger|someone goes missing], her daughter Kay and granddaughter Sam drive out to search for her. They find the house locked from the inside, post-it notes reminding Edna of everyday things, and [black mould spreading across the walls|images|plants, trees and fungus]. Edna comes back the next morning, barefoot and muddy, with no memory of where she has been and a dark bruise on her chest, and as her mind slips, [the house itself begins to twist into endless corridors|threat|evil places].
